correctness.rationale: Exhaustive line parametrization leads to a separable 1+3+24 bitangent tower. The rational part is controlled by duplication on E: v^2=u^3+1: each rational elliptic doubling fibre consists of P and P+(-1,0), whose v-coordinates have ratio -3/(u+1)^2. For q congruent 2 mod 3, -3 is nonsquare, giving exactly one square z in each nonempty fibre. The map on square z is injective, with one excluded square z at each of r=+/-2, giving exact two/four frequencies. Independent direct affine-line square-condition enumeration verifies all permissible parameters over 24 primes up to 101; the proof covers all prime powers.

value.rationale: A motivated natural invariant of a nontrivial genus-three curve family is classified over infinitely many finite fields, with a sharp two-valued arithmetic rigidity theorem and exact family-wide frequencies. The elliptic doubling involution explains why only two possibilities occur and gives additional structural content beyond a numerical table. It does not claim novelty of the geometric 28-bitangent or group-orbit counts.
